summary:
Implementation plan for OnlyCreation distinct homepage workflows:
1. Homepage routing & state separation (Create an Ad, Generate Images, Content Engine, AI Team Hub).
2. Create an Ad dedicated step-by-step interview, creative direction synthesis, and actual ad generation/editing with client-side overlay canvas.
3. Content Engine video workspace with video generation, Canvas/WebCodecs editing & export, timestamped clipping, and deep video analysis.
4. AI Team Hub unification with coordinating project manager, specialist agents, real employee tasks, and project linkages.
5. Personal context, brand guidelines, and AI safety controls.
